entries.en: Trumpington held the ladder steady while I retrieved the kite from the hedge.
entries.zh: 特兰平顿扶稳梯子，我则从树篱中取回风筝。

entries.en: Syme had packed the plates carefully, but one cup still arrived broken.
entries.zh: 赛姆仔细打包了盘子，但仍有一个杯子送到时碎了。

entries.en: Strathallan asked for a pencil because the pen had leaked inside the bag.
entries.zh: 斯特拉撒伦要了一支铅笔，因为钢笔在包里漏墨了。

entries.en: Sacre noticed the missing button just before the group photograph was taken.
entries.zh: 就在拍摄集体照之前，萨克发现少了一颗纽扣。

entries.en: Rowena left the last slice of cake for the friend who was running late.
entries.zh: 罗威娜把最后一块蛋糕留给了那位未能准时赶来的朋友。

entries.en: Phillipe moved the painting away from the window when the rain started coming in.
entries.zh: 雨水开始飘进来时，菲利普把画移到了远离窗户的地方。

entries.en: Penshurst offered to carry the empty cases back after the concert.
entries.zh: 彭斯赫斯特提出音乐会结束后把那些空箱子搬回去。

entries.en: Ms Lynd found the receipt folded inside the book she had lent me.
entries.zh: 林德女士在借给我的那本书里发现了折好的收据。

entries.en: Laure stopped stirring the soup long enough to answer the door.
entries.zh: 洛尔暂停搅汤，去应了一下门。

entries.en: Lantau had brought an extra blanket, so nobody needed to leave early.
entries.zh: 兰陶多带了一条毯子，因此没有人需要提前离开。

entries.en: Lynette checked both coat pockets before asking whether anyone had seen her keys.
entries.zh: 利奈特检查了外套的两个口袋，然后才问有没有人见到她的钥匙。

entries.en: Kays set the damaged chair aside instead of putting it out for the guests.
entries.zh: 凯斯把损坏的椅子放到一旁，没有拿出来给客人坐。

entries.en: Harrold returned with a larger envelope because the photographs would not fit.
entries.zh: 那些照片装不进去，所以哈罗德拿了一个更大的信封回来。

entries.en: Gabler listened to the recording twice before deciding where to end the scene.
entries.zh: 加布勒把录音听了两遍，才决定这一幕在哪里结束。

entries.en: Fitzgibbon had saved the broken handle, hoping the carpenter could repair it.
entries.zh: 菲茨吉本留着断掉的把手，希望木匠能修好它。

entries.en: Corfield spread the wet drawings across the table and opened another window.
entries.zh: 科菲尔德把湿画摊在桌上，又打开了一扇窗。

entries.en: Calloway waited for the kettle to boil before bringing out the cups.
entries.zh: 卡洛韦等水壶里的水烧开后才拿出杯子。

entries.en: The director preserved a sense of Britishness without filling every scene with flags.
entries.zh: 导演保留了英国风格，却没有让每个场景都布满旗帜。

entries.en: Brigante could hear the rehearsal through the wall but could not make out the words.
entries.zh: 布里甘特隔着墙能听见排练的声音，却听不清具体的话。

entries.en: Beechey brought two cushions so the children could sit comfortably on the bench.
entries.zh: 比奇带来两个坐垫，好让孩子们舒舒服服地坐在长凳上。

entries.en: She cut the Battenberg into small slices and passed the plate around.
entries.zh: 她把巴腾堡蛋糕切成小片，让大家传着取用。

entries.en: Banja found a quiet corner where the paint could dry undisturbed.
entries.zh: 班贾找了个安静角落，让颜料可以不受打扰地晾干。

entries.en: My photograph of Alcatraz Island slipped out when I opened the album.
entries.zh: 我打开相册时，拍摄阿尔卡特拉兹岛的那张照片滑了出来。

entries.en: Thorson wrapped the clock in a towel before placing it in the suitcase.
entries.zh: 索尔森先用毛巾包好钟，再把它放进行李箱。

entries.en: Szabo asked us to leave enough room for the door to open fully.
entries.zh: 绍博请我们留出足够的空间，让门能完全打开。

entries.en: Mr Stahl remembered the tune but needed help with the final verse.
entries.zh: 斯特尔先生记得曲调，但最后一节的歌词需要别人提醒。

entries.en: Shriver brought the parcel inside before the cardboard became completely soaked.
entries.zh: 在纸板完全湿透之前，施赖弗把包裹搬进了屋。

entries.en: Sebastiano tried the smaller key first, then searched the drawer again.
entries.zh: 塞巴斯蒂亚诺先试了那把较小的钥匙，然后又翻了一遍抽屉。

entries.en: Saeed kept the old frame even after replacing the photograph inside it.
entries.zh: 即使换掉了里面的照片，萨伊德仍留着那个旧相框。

entries.en: Rosamond had already folded the map when we decided to take a different route.
entries.zh: 我们决定换一条路线时，罗莎蒙德已经把地图折好了。

entries.en: The notebook I brought home from Piacenza still had a train ticket inside.
entries.zh: 我从皮亚琴察带回家的那本笔记本里仍夹着一张火车票。

entries.en: Joffe asked whether the cracked bowl could be kept for holding pencils.
entries.zh: 约菲问那个裂了的碗能不能留下来放铅笔。

entries.en: Howitt put a folded newspaper under the table leg to stop it wobbling.
entries.zh: 豪伊特在桌腿下垫了一张折好的报纸，免得桌子晃动。

entries.en: Hildegard lent me a basket large enough to hold all the costumes.
entries.zh: 希尔德加德借给我一个篮子，大得足以装下所有戏服。

entries.en: The envelope from Henkel contained a second copy of the invoice.
entries.zh: 汉高寄来的信封里装着发票的另一份副本。

entries.en: We left the spare furniture with friends in Greenford while the flat was being painted.
entries.zh: 公寓刷漆期间，我们把暂时不用的家具放在格林福德的朋友那里。

entries.en: Evita had brought a notebook, but the rain made it impossible to draw outside.
entries.zh: 埃维塔带了笔记本，可雨让人无法在户外画画。

entries.meaningZh: 二亚乙基三胺〔化学缩写〕
entries.en: The bottle of dien remained unopened while the students examined the apparatus.
entries.zh: 学生们查看仪器时，那瓶二亚乙基三胺一直没有打开。

entries.en: Berthe left a note explaining why the large cupboard had to stay empty.
entries.zh: 贝尔特留了一张便条，解释为什么那个大橱柜必须空着。

entries.en: Asif offered to repair the loose shelf before we put the books back.
entries.zh: 阿西夫提出在我们把书放回去之前先修好松动的搁板。

entries.en: The illustrator moved Zebedee closer to the edge of the unfinished scene.
entries.zh: 插画师把未完成画面中的西庇太移到了更靠近边缘的位置。

entries.en: Violetta kept the torn page because the address was still readable.
entries.zh: 维奥莱塔留着那页破损的纸，因为上面的地址还能看清。

entries.en: Vickery covered the keyboard with a cloth before sanding the window frame.
entries.zh: 打磨窗框之前，维克里用布盖住了键盘。

entries.en: Vander chose a seat near the aisle so he could leave quietly.
entries.zh: 范德选了一个靠近过道的座位，好让自己能安静地离开。

entries.en: Tron found a dry place for the boxes beneath the staircase.
entries.zh: 特龙在楼梯下面找了个干燥的地方放箱子。

entries.en: Snelling had mended the curtain, but the original stain was still visible.
entries.zh: 斯内林补好了窗帘，但原来的污渍仍看得见。

entries.en: Sergiu carried the empty frame downstairs while I wrapped the glass.
entries.zh: 我包玻璃时，塞尔久把空画框搬下了楼。

entries.en: The invoice from Schlumberger was still on my desk when the accountant arrived.
entries.zh: 会计到来时，斯伦贝谢的发票仍放在我的书桌上。

entries.en: Schafer took the muddy boots off before stepping onto the new carpet.
entries.zh: 谢弗先脱掉沾满泥的靴子，再踏上新地毯。

entries.en: Rendall found the lost sketch beneath a stack of unopened envelopes.
entries.zh: 伦德尔在一摞未拆的信封下面找到了丢失的素描。

entries.en: Reade brought the folding chairs, but we still needed another table.
entries.zh: 里德带来了折叠椅，但我们还需要一张桌子。

entries.en: Penhaligon asked for the music to be turned down during the interview.
entries.zh: 彭哈利根要求在面谈期间把音乐调小一些。

entries.en: Pasco had washed the brushes and left them beside the sink to dry.
entries.zh: 帕斯科洗好了画笔，把它们放在水槽边晾干。

entries.en: Padraig kept his promise to return the tent before the weekend.
entries.zh: 帕德里克遵守承诺，在周末之前归还了帐篷。

entries.en: Overend wanted a smaller frame that would fit between the two shelves.
entries.zh: 奥弗伦想要一个能放进两层搁板之间的较小画框。

entries.en: The host poured some Orvieto into a glass and offered it to me.
entries.zh: 主人往杯子里倒了些奥维多白葡萄酒，请我喝。

entries.en: Our friends in Olomouc kept the books until we could collect them.
entries.zh: 我们在奥洛莫乌茨的朋友替我们保管那些书，等我们去取。

entries.en: Noam rolled up the rug so there would be room to practise.
entries.zh: 诺姆卷起地毯，腾出地方来练习。

entries.en: Mohamad set the alarm early because the borrowed van had to be returned.
entries.zh: 穆罕默德把闹钟定得很早，因为借来的货车必须归还。

entries.en: McCorquodale found the missing glasses hanging from the front of the shirt.
entries.zh: 麦科克代尔发现丢失的眼镜挂在衬衫前襟上。

entries.en: Mathis kept one hand on the door while the last box was carried through.
entries.zh: 最后一个箱子搬过门口时，马蒂斯一直用一只手扶着门。

entries.en: Ms Marta had brought an extra copy in case somebody forgot the script.
entries.zh: 玛尔塔女士多带了一份剧本，以备有人忘记带。

entries.en: The archive placed the letters from Manche in a separate folder.
entries.zh: 档案馆把来自芒什省的信件放进了一个单独的文件夹。

entries.en: Machado put the finished drawing face down while searching for a clean envelope.
entries.zh: 马查多把画好的那张画正面朝下放着，同时找一个干净的信封。

entries.meaningZh: 卢克丽霞〔罗马传说人物〕
entries.en: The students compared two illustrations of Lucretia without agreeing about the colours.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了两幅卢克丽霞的插画，却未能就色彩达成一致。

entries.meaningZh: 亨利·德·图卢兹－洛特雷克〔画家〕
entries.en: The catalogue included a portrait of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec beside the introduction.
entries.zh: 图录在引言旁收录了一幅亨利·德·图卢兹－洛特雷克的肖像。

entries.en: Lundgren wanted to hear the ending again before deciding which recording to keep.
entries.zh: 伦德格伦想再听一遍结尾，然后再决定保留哪份录音。

entries.en: Kwazulu asked us not to move the easel until the drawing was finished.
entries.zh: 夸祖卢请我们等画完成后再移动画架。

entries.en: Kohn carried the small table upstairs without removing the drawer.
entries.zh: 科恩没有取下抽屉，就把那张小桌子搬上了楼。

entries.en: The accountant kept the letter from Kohler with the other business correspondence.
entries.zh: 会计把科勒的来信和其他商务信函放在一起。

entries.en: We chose a photograph of Keanu Reeves for the front of our film scrapbook.
entries.zh: 我们为电影剪贴簿的最前面挑选了一张基努·里维斯的照片。

entries.en: Jepson noticed that the parcel had been left outside the wrong flat.
entries.zh: 杰普森发现包裹被放在了错误的公寓门外。

entries.en: Jeannette took the stairs slowly, keeping the bowl level with both hands.
entries.zh: 珍妮特双手端平碗，在楼梯上慢慢走着。

entries.en: Inchcape placed a folded coat on the bench for the child to sit on.
entries.zh: 英奇凯普在长凳上放了一件折好的外套，给那个孩子垫着坐。

entries.en: Howland brought the bicycle indoors when the wind blew the cover away.
entries.zh: 风把罩子吹走后，豪兰把自行车搬进了屋。

entries.en: Gaffney could not close the drawer until the tangled string had been removed.
entries.zh: 不取出缠成一团的绳子，加夫尼就没法关上抽屉。

entries.en: Fusilier offered to lend us a lamp for the evening rehearsal.
entries.zh: 菲西利耶提出借给我们一盏灯，供晚上的排练使用。

entries.en: Fiske read the final paragraph aloud before asking the group for suggestions.
entries.zh: 菲斯克先朗读了最后一段，再征求大家的建议。

entries.en: Mr Duthie found a quieter room where we could finish the recording.
entries.zh: 达西先生找了一个更安静的房间，好让我们完成录音。

entries.en: Cumberlege had left the broken cup on the shelf rather than throwing it away.
entries.zh: 坎伯利奇把破杯子留在搁板上，没有扔掉。

entries.en: Crosthwaite brought some cardboard to protect the drawings on the journey home.
entries.zh: 克罗思韦特带了些纸板，好在回家的路上保护那些画。

entries.en: In the historical novel, a Communard hides a friend's letters beneath the floorboards.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，一名巴黎公社社员把朋友的信藏在地板下面。

entries.en: Clee offered the dry chair to a guest and sat on the damp one.
entries.zh: 克利提出把干椅子让给一位客人，自己坐在湿椅子上。

entries.en: Chorlton had kept the spare screws in a small envelope inside the toolbox.
entries.zh: 乔尔顿把备用螺丝留在工具箱里的一个小信封中。

entries.en: Chernenko asked for a second sheet of paper after spilling tea on the first.
entries.zh: 茶洒到第一张纸上后，契尔年科又要了一张纸。

entries.en: She left her notebook on the back seat of the Toyota Celica.
entries.zh: 她把笔记本落在了那辆丰田赛利卡的后座上。

entries.en: Calvo had borrowed a longer cable so the microphone could reach the stage.
entries.zh: 卡尔沃借了一根更长的线，好让麦克风能接到舞台上。

entries.en: The calver stood quietly beside the gate while the other cattle moved away.
entries.zh: 其他牛走开时，那头孕牛静静地站在门边。

entries.en: Breda offered to keep the paintings until our new shelves were ready.
entries.zh: 布雷达提出替我们保管那些画，直到新搁板做好。

entries.en: Bramhall reached the last page before discovering that the ending was missing.
entries.zh: 布拉姆霍尔读到最后一页，才发现结尾缺失了。

entries.en: Biko found the old address on the back of a faded photograph.
entries.zh: 比科在一张褪色照片的背面找到了旧地址。

entries.en: We sent the repaired violin to Beauvais in a carefully padded case.
entries.zh: 我们把修好的小提琴放在仔细加了衬垫的琴盒中，寄往博韦。

entries.en: Antonov chose the smaller suitcase because it would fit beneath the seat.
entries.zh: 安东诺夫选了那个较小的行李箱，因为它能放到座位下面。

entries.en: Allinson asked us to wait until the newly painted door had dried.
entries.zh: 阿林森请我们等新刷漆的门干了再说。

entries.en: The chemical results were replicable, although the two laboratories used different instruments.
entries.zh: 尽管两个实验室使用了不同的仪器，那些化学实验结果仍能重现。

entries.en: Weinstock had promised to bring the costumes, not to perform in the play.
entries.zh: 温斯托克答应的是带来戏服，而不是在剧中表演。

entries.en: Vizcaya folded the damaged umbrella and asked whether there was somewhere to leave it.
entries.zh: 比斯卡亚收起损坏的伞，问有没有地方可以放它。

entries.en: We played Tetris until the others were ready to leave for dinner.
entries.zh: 我们一直玩俄罗斯方块，直到其他人准备好出门吃晚饭。

entries.en: Noor found a loose thread on his sleeve and carefully cut it off.
entries.zh: 努尔发现袖子上有根松脱的线，小心地剪掉了它。

entries.en: Malet put the empty basket beside the door so nobody would forget it.
entries.zh: 马莱特把空篮子放在门旁，免得有人忘了它。

entries.en: Maister offered to collect the repaired lamp on the way home.
entries.zh: 迈斯特尔提出在回家的路上取回修好的灯。

entries.en: Maddock looked under the bed and found the missing slipper behind a suitcase.
entries.zh: 马多克朝床底下看，在一个行李箱后面找到了丢失的拖鞋。

entries.en: Lombardo left the window slightly open while the floor was drying.
entries.zh: 地板晾干期间，隆巴尔多让窗户留着一道小缝。

entries.en: Ms Litton lent us a folding screen to divide the rehearsal space.
entries.zh: 利顿女士借给我们一扇折叠屏风，用来隔开排练空间。

entries.en: Kamal brought his own cup because the cupboard held only two clean ones.
entries.zh: 卡马尔带来了自己的杯子，因为橱柜里只有两个干净杯子。

entries.en: The books we sent to Hamill arrived before the furniture did.
entries.zh: 我们寄往哈米尔的书比家具先送到。

entries.en: Haden had kept the torn envelope because the return address was still clear.
entries.zh: 黑登留着那个破损的信封，因为寄件地址仍很清楚。

entries.en: Godley offered the guest a warmer coat before opening the back door.
entries.zh: 戈德利在打开后门之前，提出给客人一件更暖和的外套。

entries.en: Frankel waited until the last chord had faded before closing the piano.
entries.zh: 弗兰克尔等最后一个和弦的声音消失后才盖上钢琴。

entries.en: Fraenkel found a spare seat, but it was too far from the stage.
entries.zh: 弗伦克尔找到了一个空座位，但它离舞台太远了。

entries.en: Mr Dickenson had brought enough rope to tie all the boxes together.
entries.zh: 迪肯森先生带了足够的绳子，能把所有箱子捆在一起。

entries.en: She put a photograph of Danson Tang inside the cover of her music scrapbook.
entries.zh: 她把一张唐禹哲的照片放在音乐剪贴簿的封面内侧。

entries.en: Ms Bredon removed the old labels before lending us the storage boxes.
entries.zh: 布里登女士先去掉旧标签，再把收纳箱借给我们。

entries.en: Bibury knew where the spare key was but could not reach the shelf.
entries.zh: 拜伯里知道备用钥匙在哪里，却够不着那层搁板。

entries.en: Mr Balmain left the empty frame on the table for us to inspect.
entries.zh: 巴尔曼先生把空画框留在桌上，供我们查看。

entries.en: Athlone asked whether we could keep the noise down until the recording ended.
entries.zh: 阿思隆问我们能否在录音结束之前小声一些。

entries.en: Arnot offered to carry the fragile bowl rather than put it in a suitcase.
entries.zh: 阿诺特提出拿着那只易碎的碗，而不把它放进行李箱。

entries.en: Weatherhead had brought a spare battery, so the rehearsal could continue.
entries.zh: 韦瑟黑德带了一块备用电池，因此排练得以继续。

entries.en: Treacy found the missing programme beneath a coat on the back seat.
entries.zh: 特里西在后座的一件外套下面找到了丢失的节目单。

entries.en: Sharman wanted a plain background that would not distract from the portrait.
entries.zh: 沙曼想要一个朴素背景，不会让人把注意力从肖像上移开。

entries.en: Selleck shut the window when the papers started blowing off the desk.
entries.zh: 纸张开始被吹离书桌时，赛莱克关上了窗户。

entries.en: Sansom had already packed the cups when we decided to make some tea.
entries.zh: 我们决定泡茶时，桑塞姆已经把杯子打包了。

entries.en: Rolston offered us the use of a shed while our roof was being repaired.
entries.zh: 我们修屋顶期间，罗尔斯顿提出让我们使用一间棚屋。

entries.en: Ms Nava found a dry cloth and wiped the rain off the case.
entries.zh: 纳瓦女士找来一块干布，擦去了箱子上的雨水。

entries.en: Meegan put the broken handle in a bag instead of leaving it on the floor.
entries.zh: 米根把断掉的把手装进袋子，没有留在地上。

entries.en: Mappin asked for the chair nearest the window so the sewing would be easier.
entries.zh: 马平要了最靠近窗户的那把椅子，好让缝纫更方便些。

entries.en: Mahesh found enough room in the cupboard for the folded blankets.
entries.zh: 马赫什发现橱柜里有足够的空间放那些叠好的毯子。

entries.en: Lindi left the drawing unfinished because the daylight was fading too quickly.
entries.zh: 林迪没有画完那幅画，因为天色暗得太快了。

entries.en: Jaya put a small cushion behind the guest's back and adjusted the lamp.
entries.zh: 贾亚在客人背后放了一个小靠垫，又调整了灯的位置。

entries.en: Helio offered to lend me a coat for the walk back to the station.
entries.zh: 赫利奥提出借给我一件外套，让我走回车站时穿。

entries.en: She kept the empty Guerlain box because it was just right for her ribbons.
entries.zh: 她留下了那个娇兰空盒子，因为它正好用来放丝带。

entries.en: Gledhill carried the lamp upstairs while I looked for a free socket.
entries.zh: 我找空插座时，格莱德希尔把灯搬上了楼。

entries.en: Everitt found a clean page near the back of the old notebook.
entries.zh: 埃弗里特在旧笔记本靠后的地方找到了一页干净的纸。

entries.en: Estefan asked us to leave the larger table free for cutting the fabric.
entries.zh: 埃斯特凡请我们把那张较大的桌子空出来裁剪布料。

entries.en: Deller had saved the cardboard tube in case her painting needed to be posted.
entries.zh: 黛尔留着那个纸筒，以备需要邮寄自己的画。

entries.en: Rain spilled over the blocked cullis and splashed against the upstairs window.
entries.zh: 雨水从堵塞的天沟溢出，溅在楼上的窗户上。

entries.en: Cribb could not finish the drawing until somebody brought another pencil.
entries.zh: 在有人又拿来一支铅笔之前，克里布没法把那幅画画完。

entries.en: The parcel I sent from Carrara reached home with one corner crushed.
entries.zh: 我从卡拉拉寄出的包裹送到家时，有一个角被压坏了。

entries.en: Cadenet had left a space on the shelf for the repaired clock.
entries.zh: 卡德内在搁板上留了一个位置，用来放修好的钟。

entries.en: Camilo put the photographs in a tin to protect them from the damp.
entries.zh: 卡米洛把照片装进铁盒，免得它们受潮。

entries.en: Belford held the bag open while I packed the remaining costumes.
entries.zh: 我把剩余的戏服装进去时，贝尔福德撑着袋口。

entries.en: Babington took the cushions indoors before the first drops of rain fell.
entries.zh: 第一滴雨落下来之前，巴宾顿就把坐垫拿进了屋。

entries.en: We left the heavy trunk with friends in Atherstone and travelled with smaller bags.
entries.zh: 我们把沉重的大箱子留在阿瑟斯通的朋友那里，带着较小的包出行。

entries.en: The collector wrapped an Astbury jug in soft cloth before moving it upstairs.
entries.zh: 收藏者用软布包好一只阿斯特伯里式陶壶，再把它搬到楼上。

entries.en: Zita chose the smaller room because it had space for her easel.
entries.zh: 思蒂选了那个较小的房间，因为里面有地方放她的画架。

entries.en: A Turkana in our drawing class offered to help frame the finished pictures.
entries.zh: 我们绘画班的一位图尔卡纳人提出帮忙给完成的画装框。

entries.en: The letter from Tournai contained a photograph neatly wrapped in a sheet of paper.
entries.zh: 图尔奈寄来的信中有一张照片，整齐地包在一张纸里。

entries.en: Stanier left the radio off so we could hear the birds outside.
entries.zh: 斯塔尼尔没有开收音机，好让我们听见外面的鸟叫。

entries.en: Rhiannon found the red scarf beneath a pile of freshly washed towels.
entries.zh: 里安农在一堆刚洗好的毛巾下面找到了红围巾。

entries.en: Could you RSVP by Monday, even if you cannot come to the dinner?
entries.zh: 即使不能来吃晚饭，你也能在周一之前答复邀请吗？

entries.en: Pullin offered us a lift after the handle broke off our suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们的行李箱把手断掉后，普林提出开车送我们一程。

entries.en: Pape had kept the old address book, although most of its pages were loose.
entries.zh: 佩普保留着旧通讯录，尽管里面的大部分书页都松脱了。

entries.en: Our copy of Middlemarch fell open at the page where I had stopped reading.
entries.zh: 我们那本《米德尔马契》翻开时，恰好停在了我上次读到的那一页。

entries.en: McGinty asked whether the large painting could stay in our hallway overnight.
entries.zh: 麦金蒂问那幅大画能否在我们走廊里放一夜。

entries.en: Marcellus put his wet coat over a chair and went to find a towel.
entries.zh: 马塞勒斯把湿外套搭在椅子上，去找毛巾了。

entries.en: Macklin had brought some spare fabric in case the costume needed another pocket.
entries.zh: 麦克林带了些备用布料，以备戏服需要再加一个口袋。

entries.en: The drawings we brought back from Larisa filled two folders and half a suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们从拉里萨带回的画装满了两个文件夹和半个行李箱。

entries.en: Iglesia offered to move the cupboard after we had taken the shelves out.
entries.zh: 伊格莱西亚提出等我们取出搁板后帮忙搬橱柜。

entries.en: Hadi found the missing button caught in the lining of the coat.
entries.zh: 哈迪发现丢失的纽扣卡在了外套的衬里中。

entries.en: Goodson waited for us beside the empty trolley while we collected our bags.
entries.zh: 我们取包时，古德森在空手推车旁等着我们。

entries.en: Cosimo had brought enough paper for everyone to make a second drawing.
entries.zh: 科西莫带的纸足够每个人再画一幅画。

entries.en: Congdon asked us to leave the scratched frame for the repairer to examine.
entries.zh: 康登请我们把刮花的画框留下来，让修理师傅查看。

entries.en: Caton had already put the ladder away when we noticed the loose curtain hook.
entries.zh: 我们发现窗帘钩松了时，卡顿已经把梯子收好了。

entries.en: The old map of Cardiganshire had been folded along the same line for years.
entries.zh: 那张卡的根郡旧地图多年来一直沿着同一道折痕折叠。

entries.en: The caretaker checked the CCTV after finding the side door open.
entries.zh: 管理员发现侧门开着后，查看了闭路电视监控。

entries.meaningZh: 布罗克斯本〔英国国会选区〕
entries.en: The archivist kept the old Broxbourne constituency papers separate from the other electoral records.
entries.zh: 档案员把布罗克斯本选区的旧文件与其他选举记录分开保存。

entries.meaningZh: 班夫郡〔苏格兰历史郡名〕
entries.en: We found an old map of Banffshire tucked behind a shelf in the study.
entries.zh: 我们在书房的一个搁板后面发现了一张塞在那里的班夫郡旧地图。

entries.en: The map of the Balearic Islands was too large to fit inside our notebook.
entries.zh: 那张巴利阿里群岛地图太大，放不进我们的笔记本。

entries.en: The second chart compares denitrification in the two soil samples.
entries.zh: 第二张图表比较了两份土壤样本中的反硝化作用。

entries.en: Sinha brought the repaired clock home, but we had forgotten where its key was.
entries.zh: 辛哈把修好的钟带回家，可我们已经忘了钥匙放在哪里。

entries.en: The letter from Sandvik arrived after we had sent the parcel to another address.
entries.zh: 我们把包裹寄往另一个地址后，山特维克的信才送到。

entries.en: Rambert found an empty shelf where the smaller paintings could stand safely.
entries.zh: 兰伯特找到了一层空搁板，可以稳妥地摆放那些较小的画。

entries.en: Rimington held the door while the others carried the old piano outside.
entries.zh: 其他人把旧钢琴搬出去时，里明顿扶着门。

entries.en: Previn left a cushion on the chair for whoever arrived next.
entries.zh: 普雷文在椅子上留了个坐垫，给接下来到的人用。

entries.en: Phillipa noticed the cracked handle before lifting the heavy basket from the floor.
entries.zh: 菲莉帕把沉重的篮子从地上提起之前，注意到把手已经裂了。

entries.en: Philipp wanted to hear the whole recording before choosing a short extract.
entries.zh: 菲利普想先听完整段录音，再挑一小段出来。

entries.en: Nivea put the clean cups on the tray and went back for the teapot.
entries.zh: 尼维亚把干净杯子放上托盘，又回去拿茶壶。

entries.en: Nicki asked for the smaller scissors to cut around the curved edge.
entries.zh: 尼基要了那把较小的剪刀，好沿着弯曲的边缘剪。

entries.en: The empty Mizuno bag was just large enough to hold the folded costumes.
entries.zh: 那个美津浓空包正好够大，能装下叠好的戏服。

entries.en: McClean offered to take the broken radio home and see whether it could be repaired.
entries.zh: 麦克林提出把坏收音机带回家，看看能不能修好。

entries.en: Marchand had kept the wooden box because its lid still fitted perfectly.
entries.zh: 马尔尚留着那个木盒，因为盒盖仍然严丝合缝。

entries.en: Ms Malden asked us to leave a clear path between the table and the door.
entries.zh: 莫尔登女士请我们在桌子和门之间留出一条畅通的路。

entries.en: MacNeice found the spare bulbs in a drawer beneath the old sewing machine.
entries.zh: 麦克尼斯在旧缝纫机下面的抽屉里找到了备用灯泡。

entries.en: Kanga had finished packing when the missing scarf turned up under a towel.
entries.zh: 坎加打包完毕后，那条不见了的围巾在一条毛巾下面找到了。

entries.en: Hersh put the wet umbrella in the hall rather than carry it into the kitchen.
entries.zh: 赫什把湿伞放在门厅里，没有带进厨房。

entries.en: Entwistle offered to lend us a larger table for the weekend workshop.
entries.zh: 恩特威斯尔提出借给我们一张更大的桌子，供周末的工作坊使用。
